statement_made: Dametrious is a massive individual with natural pass pro ability. We think he can contribute on both sides of the tackle position.

statement_made: Adam Randall is kind of a 'jackknife' for us. He’s a phenomenal kid with one of the best makeups in this draft.

statement_made: You factor in that our first-round pick is a really good player in Jaylen Waddle. We feel good about the class as a whole.
event_description: General Manager George Paton reflecting on the 2026 draft class following the trade for Jaylen Waddle.

statement_made: Dreams do come true. My message to athletes anywhere is to put in the work and really pursue it.
event_description: First media appearance after being drafted by the Miami Dolphins, discussing his journey from the NFL Academy.

statement_made: I’m going to put my head down, not say a word, and be humble. You have to earn your stripes as a rookie.
event_description: Discussing his transition from a Texas walk-on to an NFL draft pick for the Miami Dolphins.

statement_made: I got a new contract, but it don't change the goals or the ambition I got for myself and this team.

statement_made: We’re not looking to draft practice squad players. We’re looking for guys who can come in and compete.
event_description: Closing remarks on the Cincinnati Bengals' 2026 draft strategy.

statement_made: Detroit is home. I’m glad to keep this going and keep building something special with this group.

statement_made: Grateful for the belief the Chargers have in me. Time to turn that trust into results on the field.

statement_made: I can’t wait to start working. Tampa is getting a guy who plays with an edge every single snap.

statement_made: Ready to give my all to the Bucs. I’m coming in to work and earn the respect of my teammates.

statement_made: I’ll do whatever it takes to win. If they need me to block, I’m blocking. If they need more, I’m there.

statement_made: My only goal right now is to earn respect in that locker room. I’m starting from zero.
